Project.name: MAGRA
Project.annotation: Reasonix-based AI coding agent with first-class MyGRACE workflows, RTK token compression, and SNARC salience memory exposed through a web chat interface.

Actors.actor-Developer: Primary user working in the MAGRA web chat and CLI surfaces.
Actors.actor-Agent: Reasonix-derived loop executing tools, skills, plans, and edits.
Actors.actor-Reviewer: Human or agent reviewer validating MyGRACE contracts and verification evidence.

UC-001.Action: Runs MAGRACE as a Reasonix-compatible coding/chat agent.
UC-001.Goal: Keep the DeepSeek cache-first loop, tool-call repair, cost controls, dashboard, TUI, MCP, hooks, skills, sessions, and edit gates.
UC-001.Preconditions: DeepSeek-Reasonix source is available as the base project.
UC-001.AcceptanceCriteria: Existing Reasonix build, typecheck, and tests continue to pass after integration phases.

UC-002.Action: Invokes MyGRACE skills from the web chat composer.
UC-002.Preconditions: Workspace has MyGRACE indexes or can be initialized.
UC-002.AcceptanceCriteria: Composer slash suggestions and `/api/slash` expose the full namespace; each command maps to a deterministic skill/service handler.

UC-003.Action: Reads and updates MyGRACE project artifacts lazily.
UC-003.Goal: Maintain `graph-index.xml`, `plan-index.xml`, `verification-index.xml`, and per-entity files without monolithic XML artifacts.
UC-003.AcceptanceCriteria: MyGRACE lint detects missing, orphaned, and drifted per-entity files.

UC-004.Action: Runs shell, build, lint, and test commands through RTK when appropriate.
UC-004.Goal: Reduce tool-output tokens while preserving exit codes, raw-output recovery, and RTK savings telemetry.
UC-004.Preconditions: `rtk` binary is installed or bundled as a sidecar.
UC-004.AcceptanceCriteria: Shell tool has RTK auto-prefix policy, fallback to raw execution, and UI-visible savings metadata.

UC-005.Action: Captures salient tool and conversation events into SNARC memory.
UC-005.Goal: Inject relevant observed, inferred, and identity memory into future turns while avoiding low-value context bloat.
UC-005.Preconditions: Project-local SQLite memory store is available.
UC-005.AcceptanceCriteria: Post-tool, user-prompt, compaction, and stop events update or query SNARC memory with explicit provenance labels.

UC-006.Action: Uses MCP tools for MyGRACE and SNARC retrieval.
UC-006.Goal: Expose index navigation, lint, file markup inspection, memory search, patterns, context, and stats through the existing Reasonix MCP bridge.
UC-006.AcceptanceCriteria: Dashboard and loop can call MyGRACE/SNARC MCP tools or equivalent in-process adapters.

NonGoals.non-goal-1: No blind copy-paste merge of four repositories without contracts and verification.
NonGoals.non-goal-2: No replacement of Reasonix's cache-first loop with a generic agent loop.
NonGoals.non-goal-3: No mandatory Bun runtime inside the Reasonix web/chat runtime path.
NonGoals.non-goal-4: No mandatory Rust rewrite of TypeScript agent features.

Constraints.constraint-1: DeepSeek-Reasonix is the base source and compatibility surface.
Constraints.constraint-2: MyGRACE artifacts must remain index-first and per-entity; monolithic GRACE files are forbidden.
Constraints.constraint-3: RTK should remain a sidecar CLI/binary boundary unless a narrow Rust library bridge is deliberately approved.
Constraints.constraint-4: SNARC memory must be local-first, project-scoped, and explicitly label observed, inferred, and identity facts.
Constraints.constraint-5: All user-facing MyGRACE skill calls must be reachable from the web chat composer.

Risks.risk-1: Runtime mismatch: Reasonix uses Node 22, MyGRACE CLI targets Bun, RTK is Rust, and SNARC is Node 18+ TypeScript.
Risks.risk-2: Slash namespace mismatch: Reasonix skill identifiers disallow colon, while the target UX requires `/mygrace:*` commands.
Risks.risk-3: Hook mismatch: SNARC has Claude-specific PreCompact/PostCompact hooks; Reasonix currently exposes PreToolUse, PostToolUse, UserPromptSubmit, and Stop.
Risks.risk-4: Contract migration risk: DeepSeek-Reasonix has many files and cannot be marked fully MyGRACE-managed in one uncontrolled wave.
Risks.risk-5: License and attribution must remain clear across MIT and Apache-2.0 sources.

OpenQuestions.question-1: Should the distributable product name be MAGRA, MAGRACE, or MAGRA with MAGRACE as the integration layer?
OpenQuestions.question-2: Should RTK be bundled, downloaded on install, or treated as an external dependency with diagnostics?
OpenQuestions.question-3: Should SNARC deep dream use DeepSeek through Reasonix instead of Claude CLI for semantic consolidation?
